description: Jupiter Intelligence is a data resource listed in Urban and Regional Planning Resources (APA Technology Division), a curated directory of planning data, software and learning resources under the section "Vendor Data Resources > Resilience and Natural Hazards", published or maintained by as named on jupiterintel.com.
